cases.questionText: At the end of week 1 a canteen card has a balance of Rs 4500 and Rs 350 is spent every week after that. At the end of which week will the balance first fall below Rs 1000?
cases.typedAnswer:
AP: 4500, 4150, 3800, ...
a = 4500, d = -350
At the end of the 12th week the balance would fall below Rs 1000.
a12 = a + 11d = 4500 - 11 x 350 = 4500 - 3850 = Rs 650

cases.subject: Maths
cases.typedAnswer:
Let √5 be rational, so √5 = p/q where p and q are co-prime integers and q ≠ 0.
Squaring: 5 = p²/q², so p² = 5q².
So 5 divides p². Theorem: if a prime p divides q² then p divides q. So 5 divides p, p = 5c.
Then 25c² = 5q², q² = 5c², so 5 divides q² and q.
So 5 divides p and q: p and q have a common factor 5, which contradicts that they are co-prime. Hence √5 is irrational.
